site.title: Seagrass Nursery Monitoring
site.subtitle: Gibraltar Seagrass Restoration Project, North Mole

method_note: In-situ spot samples: handheld meters and test kits, read by eye. Accuracy and resolution differ from the Seneye probes, so the two are shown as separate measurements and never averaged together.

parameters.label: Ammonium (NH₄⁺, modelled)
parameters.model_note: Not measured. Worked out from the measured free ammonia, pH and temperature with the salinity in use, since NH3 and NH4+ are two sides of one equilibrium.

parameters.label: Oxygen at saturation (modelled)
parameters.model_note: Not a measurement of the oxygen in the tank. It is the most the water could hold at the measured temperature and the salinity in use, at sea-level pressure. Real dissolved oxygen sits below this whenever respiration outpaces exchange, and measuring it needs a probe.

analytes.label: Temperature
analytes.basis: TNP nursery operating set points, not a seawater range

analytes.label: Salinity
analytes.basis: Atlantic inflow ~36.2 to Mediterranean outflow ~38.4 at the Strait

analytes.label: pH
analytes.basis: surface ocean pH ~8.1; outer bounds are the nursery set points

analytes.label: Nitrate (NO₃⁻)
analytes.basis: western Mediterranean surface nitrate under ~4 umol/kg = 0.25 mg/L as NO3

analytes.label: Nitrite (NO₂⁻)
analytes.basis: upper-ocean nitrite 10-1000 nmol/L = up to ~0.046 mg/L as NO2

analytes.label: Phosphate (PO₄³⁻)
analytes.basis: western Mediterranean surface phosphate ~0.16 umol/kg = 15 ppb as PO4; the sheet records ppb, so 0.05 ppm becomes 50 ppb

analytes.label: Calcium (Ca²⁺)
analytes.basis: 412 ppm at S=35, scaling with salinity to ~452 ppm at S=38.4

analytes.label: Magnesium (Mg²⁺)
analytes.basis: 1290 ppm at S=35, scaling with salinity to ~1415 ppm at S=38.4

plugs.note: Chiller state is read from the plugs every harvest. It is shown here and switched from the Smart Life app.

energy.note: Estimated by integrating a power reading taken every half hour. Reliable over a month, approximate over a single day, and per row rather than per sump because one meter serves both of a plug's sockets.

setpoints._comment: Chiller setpoints, a floor rather than the achieved temperature: the compressor starts 1 degree above setpoint and stops at it, so the time-average sits above by roughly half the drift.
